title: Enhanced audio-tactile PPS after echolocation training
citation: Tonelli, A., et al. (2019). Enhanced audio-tactile multisensory interaction in a peripersonal task after echolocation. Experimental Brain Research.
notes: Seven-speaker looming apparatus on the participant's left side. This proxy uses a virtual moving white-noise trajectory with paired distance/timing rows, 28 tactile-only baselines, and 28 auditory-only catches. Its 500-ms pre-sound and 600-ms post-sound margins are derived software containment choices, not reported trial padding. The shared 100-ms audio-channel cue substitutes for the reported 20-ms neck vibration. Exact loudspeaker switching, gain transfer, response timeout and experimenter-started ITI remain unresolved; a complete waveform does not establish protocol or hardware equivalence.

reference_parameters.soa_values_ms_basis: Derived from seven equally spaced positions: elapsed_ms=(119-distance_cm)/34*1000, for distance_cm=[119,102,85,68,51,34,17]. Methods pp. 856-858 (DOI 10.1007/s00221-019-05469-3) report 17-cm spacing and 34 cm/s, not this numerical SOA table.
reference_parameters.software_trial_padding_basis: Derived containment only: pre=max(0,-min(SOA))=500 ms; post=max(0,max(SOA)+software cue duration-sound duration)=3500+100-3000=600 ms. The article does not report a fixed full-trial padding or response timeout; ITI is experimenter controlled.
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 84 audio-tactile trials (7 distances/timings x 12 repetitions), 28 tactile-only baseline trials, and 28 auditory-only catch trials = 140 trials per pre/post PPS session.
reference_parameters.apparatus_recreation_policy: The physical seven-loudspeaker array is represented with the toolkit's lateral binaural moving-source renderer using the reported 119-to-17 cm path and paired seven distance/timing samples.
remaining_caveats: software containment margins are derived rather than reported trial timing
shared 100-ms audio-channel cue substitutes for the reported 20-ms vibrotactile pulse

provenance.source: Tonelli et al. 2019, Methods pp. 856-858, Peripersonal space task (DOI 10.1007/s00221-019-05469-3): targets 500 ms before sound onset and 500 ms after sound offset; 3000-ms motion and 20-ms vibration; no fixed ITI. The software margins and 100-ms cue are explicitly separate implementation choices with their formula in reference_parameters.
Methods report 140 trials: 28 tactile-only, 28 catch, and 12 trials for each audio-tactile combination.
Methods report a seven-speaker array with 17 cm between loudspeakers.
